notes.title: Important update on House Of The Soul
notes.content: [p]An important update on the future of House of the Soul:[/p][p][/p][p]As time goes on, I feel as the sole developer of this project it's no longer in my best interests to continue to make the game available on the steam store. Therefore, the game will soon be delisted from the steam store and will be unavailable for purchase. I am grateful for all the support offered to this game, and if you already own it your product will not be affected, you should be able to continue playing without problems. If you encounter any problems following the delisting of House of the Soul, or want to know about any of my other projects, you can check out corinthine.co.uk for more information or to get in contact.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your continued support,[/p][p]Corinthine[/p]
